resources.string: Choose 6–32 digits. This is a separate app PIN, not your device PIN.

Try previously enabled biometrics. There is no bypass. If neither works, Android Settings → Apps → MeBot → Storage → Clear storage is a destructive last resort: it deletes this app’s local notes, saved content, settings, alarms and credentials. Export first if you can unlock. Remote provider data is not deleted. MeBot never automatically erases data after failed attempts.

Hide personal screens when you leave MeBot or lock your device. App lock does not encrypt your feed database or protect exported files. Notifications and alarm labels stay generic while enabled; stop and snooze still work.
The new PINs do not match.
Re-enter your current app PIN to change security settings. Strong enrolled biometrics are optional. Keep your PIN: enrollment changes or device lockouts can make biometrics unavailable.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$d seconds.
Protection could not be read or saved. MeBot stays locked. Restart and try again; do not clear storage unless you accept losing local data.
Authentication expired when MeBot left the foreground. Try again.
Biometrics are unavailable or cancelled. Use your app PIN.
